item.title: Quarterly Report on Bank Trading and Derivatives Activities: First Quarter 2026
item.description: Cumulative trading revenue of U.S. commercial banks and savings associations was $16.3 billion in the first quarter of 2026. Trading revenue was $1.7 billion, or 11.4 percent, more than in the previous quarter and $862 million, or 5.6 percent, more than a year earlier.

item.title: 2026 Cybersecurity and Financial System Resilience Report
item.description: The annual Cybersecurity and Financial System Resilience Report provides Congress with an overview of measures that the OCC takes to strengthen cybersecurity with respect to the agency's functions as a regulator. Functions include the supervision and regulation of financial institutions and, when applicable, third-party service providers.
item.author: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
item.category: Bank Secrecy Act & Anti-Money Laundering (BSA/AML), Digital Assets & Tokenization, Information & Cyber Security - BIT
item.source: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency

item.title: OCC’s Semiannual Risk Perspective Highlights Key Risks in Federal Banking System
item.description: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) today reported the key issues facing the federal banking system in the Semiannual Risk Perspective for Spring 2026.
item.author: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
item.category: Bank Secrecy Act & Anti-Money Laundering (BSA/AML), Capital Markets, Consumer Protection, Credit, Operational Risk Management
item.source: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency

item.title: Report to Congress on Preserving and Promoting Minority Depository Institutions
item.description: The OCC's Minority Depository Institutions (MDI) report to Congress is submitted to comply with section 367 of the Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act of 2010. As amended by the Dodd-Frank Act, section 308 of the Financial Institutions Reform, Recovery, and Enforcement Act of 1989 (FIRREA) directs the OCC to report on actions taken to carry out section 308. Section 308 describes goals for preserving MDIs and directs the Secretary of the Treasury to consult with the OCC and other federal financial regulators on methods for best achieving these goals.
item.author: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
item.category: Federal Savings Associations, Minority Depository Institutions
item.source: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency

item.title: Interest Rate Risk Statistics Report
item.description: The Interest Rate Risk Statistics Report presents interest rate risk data gathered during examinations of OCC-supervised midsize and community banks and federal savings associations (collectively, banks). The statistics are for informational purposes only and do not represent OCC-suggested limits or exposures.
item.author: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
item.category: Capital Markets, Interest Rate Risk, Treasury & Market Risk
item.source: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency

item.title: Quarterly Report on Bank Trading and Derivatives Activities: Fourth Quarter 2025
item.description: Cumulative trading revenue of U.S. commercial banks and savings associations of $14.9 billion in the fourth quarter of 2025. The fourth quarter trading revenue was $2.9 billion, or 16.3 percent, less than in the previous quarter and $680 million, or 4.4 percent, less than a year earlier.
